basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gaming enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I've been playing League of Legends since Season 3 and I main Seraphine, mostly playing support and sometimes mid. When I'm not gaming, I work as a software developer specializing in blockchain technology. I have a keen interest in cryptocurrency and often follow the latest trends and discussions in the field. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time hiking and exploring new restaurants in the city. I'm usually online in the evenings, especially on weekends, and I love engaging with the gaming community on Reddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for the past 6 years. My expertise in blockchain technology comes from both formal education and extensive self-teaching. I stay updated with the latest developments in the crypto world through online courses, webinars, and active participation in relevant subreddits.
